summary: Transfer entropy analysis reveals significant bidirectional information transfer between NH and SH albedo anomalies at 3-6 month lags (p<0.001). SH→NH is dominant at short lags. This is the first information-theoretic evidence for hemispheric albedo teleconnections, supporting H003.
next_priorities: wavelet_coherence × H003: Identify WHICH frequencies carry the information flow
convergent_cross_mapping × H001: Test if cloud buffering is causal
attractor_reconstruction × H002: Is albedo on a low-dimensional attractor?
